payload.name: Safe project-data readiness
payload.statement: Before every public operation loads strict current state, Projector performs bounded metadata readiness and either proceeds under lifetime operation access or returns an explicit inactive, busy, unavailable, upgrade, or recovery action. Initialization does not mutate during inspection and publishes configuration last. Migration requires exclusive cooperative access, resolved controlled transactions, a verified full safe backup under the user Codex data directory, validated staging, a durable pending marker, exact recognized migration bytes, and config-last recoverable publication. Version domains remain distinct. Upgrades may cross multiple releases only through the full ordered and verified migration chain; layouts with missing or invalid chain links, unknown or mixed versions, newer formats, tampering, or unsupported transitions remain untouched. New locks do not prove nonparticipating legacy code is quiescent; the first transition requires a supported restart disposition and held-old-runner corruption-negative evidence.
